entry.name: Clean install on the owner's machine
entry.expected: On the owner's machine: `terminus verify` exits 0 and prints "N session(s) checked, 0 failed"; `sqlite3 -readonly ~/.local/share/terminus/terminus.db "SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='archive_format'"` prints 2; N equals the count of transcripts still on disk on the install day (SUMMARY reports 1953); ~/terminus-format1/data still holds the old format-1 terminus.db. The 2026-10-05 format-1 binary was not saved, which the owner already accepted (SUMMARY deviation).
entry.why_human: Out-of-reach resource: it needs the owner's real store and the moved-aside folder (~/.local/share/terminus, ~/terminus-format1), which this verification was told not to touch, and the move it checks is a one-time, irreversible step already taken on that machine. No probe in the repository can reproduce it.
